text:
Avoid combination.

Omeprazole is an inhibitor of the CYP2C19 enzyme [omeprazole:clinical_pharmacology:8], which is required to convert the clopidogrel prodrug into its active metabolite [clopidogrel:boxed_warning:0]. Concomitant use of omeprazole impairs this metabolic activation, leading to reduced plasma concentrations of the active metabolite and a significant decrease in the antiplatelet activity of clopidogrel [clopidogrel:drug_interactions:2, omeprazole:drug_interactions:4].
